module: Minimal traffic role ("empty"). It inherits from baseRole but empties the actions table: no extra action or specific AI is applied to the vehicle. Useful for a traffic vehicle you want to leave completely passive.
notes: The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/traffic/baseRole')(C, ...) wraps class C.
init copies the baseActions of baseRole into self.actions then sets self.baseActions to nil.

init.desc: Called when the role is created. Copies the base actions (self.baseActions) into self.actions, then removes self.baseActions; no role-specific action is added.
